title: Adequately affine pushforward of universally adequate algebra maps
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $\mathcal X,\mathcal Y$ be algebraic stacks over $k$ [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack], and let $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ be adequately affine [def-sfb-adequately-affine-morphism]. Let $u:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a morphism of arbitrary quasi-coherent commutative $\mathcal O_{\mathcal X}$-algebras [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra]. Suppose $u$ is universally adequate, meaning that every section of $\mathcal B$ on every smooth scheme test of $\mathcal X$ has a positive power lifting to $\mathcal A$ after an etale covering, in the sense of [def-sfb-adequately-affine-morphism]. Then $f_*\mathcal A\to f_*\mathcal B$ on the smooth-etale site of $\mathcal Y$ is universally adequate. Neither surjectivity nor injectivity of $u$, finite generation of the algebras, nor Noetherianity of the stacks is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 4.1.7, implication (2) implies (1), proof before the locally Noetherian finite-type variants, printed pp.17--18; explicitly concludes that f_*A to f_*B is universally adequate. Primary arXiv:1005.2398v3 read online at https://arxiv.org/html/1005.2398v3#S4.SS1; local PDF WANTED.

proof.text: Factor $u$ as $\mathcal A\xrightarrow{q}\mathcal C\xrightarrow{j}\mathcal B$ using [lem-sfb-stack-algebra-smooth-image]. Thus $q$ is a surjection and $j$ is injective on smooth tests. The map $j$ is universally adequate: on each smooth test any local lift $a$ of a power under $u$ gives the lift $q(a)$ under $j$. Since $f$ is adequately affine, its defining lifting property applies to $q$, so $f_*q:f_*\mathcal A\to f_*\mathcal C$ is universally adequate [def-sfb-adequately-affine-morphism].

It remains to lift powers of sections through $f_*j$. It suffices to do so for every affine smooth test $V\to\mathcal Y$, since an arbitrary test is covered by affine opens. Put $\mathcal Z=\mathcal X\times_{\mathcal Y}V$; it is algebraic by [lem-sfb-algebraic-stack-fibre-products] and quasi-compact by the quasi-compactness clause of $f$ [def-sfb-stack-qcqs-morphism]. Choose a smooth surjective atlas $p:U\to\mathcal Z$ with $U$ a quasi-compact scheme, by [lem-sfb-algebraic-stack-quasicompact-surjection]. The projection $\mathcal Z\to\mathcal X$ is smooth, and so is $U\to\mathcal X$, by [lem-sfb-stack-smooth-permanence]. For $b\in\Gamma(\mathcal Z,\mathcal B|_{\mathcal Z})$, use universal adequacy of $j$ on this smooth test $U$: there is an etale covering with local sections of $\mathcal C$ lifting positive powers of $b|_U$.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-sieve-finite-affine-refinement] to the covering sieve of this etale covering of $U$ (take the base scheme to be $U$ and the etale object to be its identity). Obtain finitely many affine etale tests $W_i\to U$, jointly surjective, each factoring through a member of the chosen covering. Pull back the corresponding lift to obtain $c_i\in\Gamma(W_i,\mathcal C|_{W_i})$ with $j(c_i)=b|_{W_i}^{n_i}$, $n_i>0$. Set $N=\prod_i n_i$ and $d_i=c_i^{N/n_i}$. Then $j(d_i)=b|_{W_i}^{N}$. For an empty cover set $N=1$; the empty atlas then covers the empty stack. Each $W_i\to\mathcal Z$ and each relation space $R_{ij}=W_i\times_{\mathcal Z}W_j\to\mathcal X$ is smooth by [lem-sfb-stack-smooth-permanence], since etale maps are smooth in [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].

On $R_{ij}$ the images under $j$ of the two restrictions of $d_i,d_j$ both equal the restriction of $b^N$. The smooth-pullback injectivity in [lem-sfb-stack-algebra-smooth-image] therefore makes those restrictions equal. By [lem-sfb-smooth-cover-section-descent], the compatible $d_i$ descend to $d\in\Gamma(\mathcal Z,\mathcal C|_{\mathcal Z})$, and equality can be checked on the same cover, so $j(d)=b^N$. The direct-image formula in [def-sfb-adequately-affine-morphism] identifies this with a power lift on $V$. Thus $f_*j$ has power lifts on every affine smooth test, and hence is universally adequate on all smooth tests by taking an affine open covering.

Combine the two maps without assuming either is surjective on sections. For any smooth test $T$ and section $b\in(f_*\mathcal B)(T)$, the just-proved adequacy of $f_*j$ gives an etale cover $T_i\to T$ and $c_i\in(f_*\mathcal C)(T_i)$ with $j(c_i)=b|_{T_i}^{N_i}$. Adequacy of $f_*q$ gives etale covers $T_{ij}\to T_i$ and $a_{ij}\in(f_*\mathcal A)(T_{ij})$ with $q(a_{ij})=c_i|_{T_{ij}}^{M_{ij}}$. Consequently $u(a_{ij})=b|_{T_{ij}}^{N_iM_{ij}}$, with positive exponent. The composite covering is etale, by the covering-composition axiom [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. This is exactly universal adequacy of $f_*u$ [def-sfb-adequately-affine-morphism].

mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q104-ff4c38e4a (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: This is a first split. Statement and stmt_deps are byte-identical to base and live, and the item is still unsplit on live, so it has not been superseded. I checked the proof against Alper arXiv:1005.2398v3, Lemma 4.1.7 (2)⇒(1), and Def. 3.4.3/4.1.1.

Steps:
- Step 1: the image factorization A→C→B, then adequate affineness of f applied to the surjection q. j(q(a))=u(a) gives that j is universally adequate.
- Step 2: reduction to an affine smooth test V. Z=X×_YV is algebraic (04T2) and quasi-compact (f is qcqs), with a quasi-compact atlas U. Z→X and U→X are smooth by the new permanence node.
- Step 3: finite affine étale refinement (Lean lemma with W=id_U, U compact), then the common exponent N=∏n_i with d_i=c_i^{N/n_i}.
- Step 4: smooth-source injectivity on R_ij, then 076S descent and equality checked on the cover.
- Step 5: composing the two power lifts.
This replaces Alper's 3.4.5 global lift with étale-local lifts glued over Z. The route is valid and uses only smooth-test injectivity.

New nodes, all true and statement-only:
- stack-algebra-smooth-image: 06WV(2)-(4) and 0GQF, with Γ=Hom(O,−) left exact.
- smooth-cover-section-descent: 076S with F=O. Checked on the identity cover and on the empty stack.
- stack-smooth-permanence: 075V/075W. The existing lem-sfb-stack-chartwise-smooth-etale-calculus covers only representable morphisms, so this is a generalization, not a duplicate.
No other node duplicates them (equalizer/descent/image grep over the snapshot DAG).
